topics.label: URLs & URIs
topics.desc: Scheme, host, path, query, and fragment structure that names every web resource and drives routing, origins, and links.

topics.label: HTTP Request/Response
topics.desc: The stateless request/response cycle with methods, status codes, and headers that underpins all browser-server communication.

topics.label: DNS Resolution
topics.desc: Hierarchical hostname-to-IP lookup whose latency and caching gate every navigation before a connection is even opened.

topics.label: Browser Rendering Pipeline
topics.desc: Parse-to-pixels flow of DOM, CSSOM, layout, paint, and compositing that determines what users see and how fast.

topics.label: Same-Origin Policy
topics.desc: The browser's core isolation boundary keyed on scheme+host+port that restricts cross-origin script access to resources.

topics.label: Cookies & Sessions
topics.desc: Server-set state tokens with scope, expiry, and SameSite flags that add identity and continuity to stateless HTTP.

topics.label: Web Standards & Specs
topics.desc: WHATWG, W3C, TC39, and Baseline processes that define HTML, DOM, CSS, and JS interoperability across engines.

topics.label: Semantic HTML
topics.desc: Meaning-bearing elements like nav, main, and article that give documents structure for accessibility, SEO, and tooling.

topics.label: CSS Box Model
topics.desc: Content, padding, border, and margin with box-sizing rules that govern how every element computes its size.

topics.label: Cascade & Specificity
topics.desc: The origin, specificity, and order rules plus layers that resolve which conflicting CSS declaration ultimately wins.

topics.label: Flexbox & Grid
topics.desc: Two-dimensional layout engines for distributing space along axes and tracks, replacing float and table hacks.

topics.label: Responsive Design
topics.desc: Fluid layouts, media and container queries, and relative units that adapt one codebase across viewports and devices.

topics.label: CSS Architecture
topics.desc: Methodologies like BEM, utility-first, and CSS-in-JS that scope, name, and scale styles without specificity wars.

topics.label: Animations & Transforms
topics.desc: GPU-friendly transitions, keyframes, and transforms that animate transform and opacity to avoid layout thrash.

topics.label: JavaScript Core
topics.desc: Closures, prototypes, scope, and coercion semantics that define how JS behaves and where its sharp edges lie.

topics.label: DOM API
topics.desc: The live tree interface for querying, mutating, and traversing document nodes that all UI manipulation flows through.

topics.label: Event Model
topics.desc: Capture/bubble propagation, delegation, and listener options that route user and system events through the DOM.

topics.label: Event Loop & Async
topics.desc: Single-threaded loop with task and microtask queues, Promises, and async/await that schedule non-blocking work.

topics.label: Fetch & XHR
topics.desc: Promise-based network APIs for requests, streaming, and aborting that drive client-side data loading over HTTP.

topics.label: ES Modules
topics.desc: Standardized import/export with static analysis and live bindings that enable tree-shaking and native browser loading.

topics.label: TypeScript
topics.desc: Structural static typing over JavaScript that catches errors early and powers editor tooling for large frontends.

topics.label: Component Model
topics.desc: Encapsulated, composable UI units with props and children that form the building blocks of every modern framework.

topics.label: Declarative UI
topics.desc: Describing UI as a function of state so the framework, not the developer, reconciles the DOM to match.

topics.label: Virtual DOM & Diffing
topics.desc: In-memory tree diffed against prior renders to compute minimal DOM mutations, trading memory for update simplicity.

topics.label: Reactivity & Signals
topics.desc: Fine-grained dependency tracking via signals or observables that updates only the DOM affected by a state change.

topics.label: Lifecycle & Hooks
topics.desc: Mount, update, and effect phases exposed via hooks that let components run side effects and manage resources.

topics.label: Client-Side Routing
topics.desc: History-API-driven view switching without full reloads, mapping URLs to components in single-page applications.

topics.label: Web Components
topics.desc: Custom elements, shadow DOM, and templates that offer framework-agnostic, encapsulated reusable widgets.

topics.label: Local Component State
topics.desc: Per-component state owned and mutated within a component, the default and simplest unit of UI state.

topics.label: Global State Stores
topics.desc: Centralized stores like Redux or Zustand that share and coordinate state across distant components predictably.

topics.label: Unidirectional Data Flow
topics.desc: State flowing down and events flowing up, making updates traceable and rendering deterministic across a tree.

topics.label: Server State & Caching
topics.desc: Libraries like TanStack Query that cache, dedupe, and revalidate remote data, separating it from local UI state.

topics.label: Derived State & Memoization
topics.desc: Computing values from existing state and caching results to avoid redundant work and unnecessary re-renders.

topics.label: Forms & Validation
topics.desc: Controlled inputs, schema validation, and submission handling that manage the messiest source of client state.

topics.label: Optimistic Updates
topics.desc: Applying expected mutation results immediately and rolling back on failure to make UIs feel instant over the network.

topics.label: Client-Side Rendering
topics.desc: Shipping a JS bundle that builds the DOM in the browser, maximizing interactivity at the cost of first paint.

topics.label: Server-Side Rendering
topics.desc: Rendering HTML on the server per request for fast first paint and SEO, then hydrating it on the client.

topics.label: Static Generation
topics.desc: Pre-rendering pages at build time into cacheable HTML for the fastest delivery of content that changes rarely.

topics.label: Hydration
topics.desc: Attaching event listeners and state to server-rendered HTML so static markup becomes interactive in the browser.

topics.label: Streaming & Partial Render
topics.desc: Flushing HTML in chunks and resuming hydration progressively so users see and use content before the full page loads.

topics.label: Server Components
topics.desc: Components that render only on the server and send no JS, shrinking bundles while colocating server data fetching.

topics.label: Edge & CDN Delivery
topics.desc: Running rendering and caching at points of presence near users to cut round-trip latency for HTML and assets.

topics.label: Core Web Vitals
topics.desc: Field metrics LCP, INP, and CLS that quantify loading, interactivity, and visual stability of real user experiences.

topics.label: Critical Rendering Path
topics.desc: The render-blocking sequence of HTML, CSS, and JS that must complete before first paint and can be optimized to shrink it.

topics.label: Code Splitting & Lazy Loading
topics.desc: Breaking bundles into route- or component-level chunks loaded on demand to shrink initial payload and time-to-interactive.

topics.label: Asset Optimization
topics.desc: Image formats, compression, fonts, and bundler minification that reduce bytes over the wire without quality loss.

topics.label: ARIA & Accessibility
topics.desc: Roles, states, semantics, keyboard support, and contrast that make interfaces usable with assistive technology per WCAG.

topics.label: Perf Budgets & RUM
topics.desc: Enforced size and timing thresholds plus real-user monitoring that catch regressions before they reach production.

topics.label: Web Storage & IndexedDB
topics.desc: Client persistence via localStorage and IndexedDB for caching, offline data, and state surviving page reloads.

topics.label: Service Workers & PWA
topics.desc: Programmable network proxy enabling offline support, caching strategies, and installable progressive web apps.

topics.label: Web Workers
topics.desc: Background OS threads with message passing that move heavy computation off the main thread to keep UIs responsive.

topics.label: WebSockets & Realtime
topics.desc: Full-duplex persistent connections, plus SSE, that push live updates for chat, collaboration, and dashboards.

topics.label: CORS
topics.desc: Header-based protocol with preflights that lets servers safely relax the same-origin policy for cross-origin requests.

topics.label: WebAssembly
topics.desc: Portable binary bytecode running near-native in the browser, enabling C/C++/Rust workloads beyond JavaScript's reach.

topics.label: Canvas, WebGL & WebGPU
topics.desc: Low-level drawing and GPU APIs for 2D canvas, accelerated WebGL, and modern WebGPU rendering and compute.
